title: Ink Purikura film-stock shaders, strip composer, and camera controller
acceptance_criteria: Pure TypeScript film-stock processors (sumi-e, riso, newsprint) with WebGL2 shader sources and deterministic Canvas 2D ImageData kernels, seeded torn-paper strip composer with date hanko stamp and vector stroke/sticker model, bundled sample paper portrait generator, opt-in camera lifecycle controller, and shutter-clack cue in lib/sound.ts pass all unit tests.
problem: Ink Purikura Photobooth (/play/booth) needs a zero-dependency film-stock shader and deterministic Canvas 2D fallback for sumi-e ink wash, riso two-colour halftone, and newsprint dot screen, a seeded torn-paper strip and vector purikura doodle/sticker model, a bundled sample paper portrait when no camera is available, an opt-in camera lifecycle controller, and a WebAudio shutter-clack cue.
action_items: Extend lib/sound.ts and lib/sound.test.ts with a shutter-clack cue (short noise-burst plus mechanical click capped at <= -18 dB, silent when the site sound toggle is muted).

Implement lib/booth/film-stock.ts exporting the three film-stock definitions ('sumi-e', 'riso', 'newsprint'), raw WebGL2 vertex/fragment shader sources, a WebGL2 quad renderer with webglcontextlost fallback, and a deterministic Canvas 2D ImageData kernel for each film stock (sumi-e luminance threshold bands + paper grain, riso two-colour rotated halftone screens with multiply blend and slight misregistration, newsprint 45-degree dot screen on newsprint tint).

Implement lib/booth/sample-portrait.ts and lib/booth/camera.ts providing a deterministic procedural paper portrait generator (used when camera is absent, denied, or insecure) and an opt-in getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'user', width: { ideal: 960 } }, audio: false }) controller that starts only on user action and stops all tracks after the 4th capture, on close, on visibility hidden, or on unmount.

Implement lib/booth/strip.ts for assembling 4 captured frames onto a ~600x1800 vertical torn-paper strip (seeded random polyline edge mask, slight frame tilt, red circular date hanko stamp formatted YYYY.MM.DD, and 'otohime.dev' footer) plus a vector purikura decoration model (ink pen strokes with configurable widths/colours, eraser, undo, clear, and draggable/scalable/rotatable doodle stickers).

Add unit tests in lib/booth/booth.test.ts and standalone verifier scripts/verify-booth-engine.mjs covering distinct non-blank pixel outputs across sumi-e/riso/newsprint, seeded torn-paper mask determinism, 4-frame strip layout, vector stroke/sticker undo/clear invariants, camera track cleanup on 4th shot and abort, and record execution evidence in projects/otohime-dev-two-new-play-toys-paper-and-ink-style-bold-and-e/task-1-evidence.md.
interfaces: lib/booth/film-stock.ts; lib/booth/strip.ts; lib/booth/camera.ts; lib/booth/sample-portrait.ts; lib/booth/booth.test.ts; lib/sound.ts; lib/sound.test.ts; scripts/verify-booth-engine.mjs; projects/otohime-dev-two-new-play-toys-paper-and-ink-style-bold-and-e/task-1-evidence.md
non_goals: external image uploads or network requests
Three.js dependency for the 2D quad shader

title: Ink Purikura Photobooth route, purikura doodle layer, and print/PNG export
acceptance_criteria: /play/booth renders the Ink Purikura Photobooth where visitors opt into their webcam or use the sample paper portrait fallback, select sumi-e, riso, or newsprint film stock, run a 3-2-1 countdown with shutter clack and reduced-motion-safe ink flash to capture 4 frames into a torn-paper strip with a date hanko stamp and otohime.dev footer, doodle with the purikura ink pen and stickers, download a valid PNG, and print a ~5x15cm strip with zero network image uploads.
problem: Visitors have no interactive /play/booth route to take or simulate 4-frame ink photobooth strips, switch film stocks live, decorate with purikura pen strokes and stickers, or export/print the finished torn-paper strip.
action_items: Read installed Next 16 docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing route code; update next.config.ts so Permissions-Policy allows camera=(self), microphone=() on /play/booth (while preserving /play for existing peep-box tests).

Build app/(site)/(app)/play/booth/page.tsx, app/(site)/(app)/play/booth/booth.css, and app/(site)/(app)/play/booth/_components/booth-studio.tsx wrapped in ViewTransition, displaying the privacy notice ('Your camera stays in this tab. Nothing is uploaded.'), opt-in 'Open camera' button, and explicit 'Use sample portrait' fallback button (also triggered automatically when camera permission is denied or unavailable).

Wire live film-stock switching ('sumi-e', 'riso', 'newsprint'), the 3-2-1 countdown with aria-live='polite' status updates, WebAudio shutter clack via lib/sound-client.ts, and CSS ink-flash overlay that suppresses flash animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce while keeping the numeric countdown and static click indicator.

Render the assembled 600x1800 torn-paper 4-frame strip with the red date hanko stamp and 'otohime.dev' footer, interactive pointer/keyboard purikura ink pen (widths, sumi/vermilion/indigo/gold colours, eraser, undo, clear) and draggable/scalable/rotatable doodle stickers, PNG download ('otohime-booth-YYYYMMDD.png' via canvas.toBlob), and a 'Print strip' button backed by an @media print stylesheet sizing the strip to ~5x15cm and hiding UI chrome.

Suppress .rise transform on .rise:has(.booth-root) so fixed/sticky controls stay strictly inside both 1366x768 desktop and 390x844 mobile viewports; add Chromium E2E tests in e2e/booth.test.ts covering fake-camera 4-frame capture, denied-camera sample portrait fallback, film-stock switching, pen/sticker decoration + undo, PNG magic-byte download verification, zero image-upload network requests, prefers-reduced-motion suppression, and 390x844 mobile layout; record evidence in projects/otohime-dev-two-new-play-toys-paper-and-ink-style-bold-and-e/task-2-evidence.md.

title: Pipeline Pachinko deterministic Verlet engine and stage rules
acceptance_criteria: Pure 2D Verlet simulation in lib/pachinko/sim.ts deterministically steps ink-ball records at 1/120 s through ingest pegs, a dedupe gate that bounces duplicate keys with a 'DUP' stamp, a two-ball join funnel with lone-ball late-arrival timeout release, a 6-bucket partition splitter (p0..p5), and a dead-letter queue (DLQ) gutter, computing rolling 5 s records/sec, late-arrival %, DLQ count, and triggering the on-call pager state on 3 consecutive DLQ hits.
problem: Pipeline Pachinko (/play/pachinko) needs a lightweight, deterministic 2D physics and data-pipeline stage engine with zero external physics dependencies so collision math, stage transitions, throughput metrics, and the 3-streak DLQ pager Easter egg can be unit-tested deterministically.
action_items: Implement lib/pachinko/sim.ts with a seeded PRNG (mulberry32), fixed 1/120 s Verlet integration with substeps, velocity clamping, spatial-hash ball-ball collisions (capped at <= 150 active balls), circle-vs-peg and circle-vs-segment restitution, plunger launch velocity mapping, and horizontal tilt/nudge acceleration.

Model the five pipeline stages from top to bottom in lib/pachinko/sim.ts: (1) ingest peg lattice, (2) dedupe filter gate that detects duplicate record keys within a recent window, bounces them upward, and stamps the ball 'DUP', (3) join funnel that holds the first arriving ball until a second arrives to emit one merged larger ball (with a deterministic timeout that releases a lone waiting ball as a late arrival so the funnel never stalls), (4) partition splitter routing balls into 6 buckets (p0..p5) by key hash, and (5) dead-letter queue (DLQ) side gutter.

Compute live readouts in lib/pachinko/sim.ts: bucket counts (p0..p5), rolling 5-second throughput (records/sec), late-arrival percentage (records exceeding transit threshold or released via join timeout), total DLQ count, and consecutive DLQ streak counter that sets pagerActive = true when dlqStreak reaches 3 (and resets streak on dismissal or non-DLQ bucket landing), plus deterministic helpers/fixtures for backfill floods and DLQ streak testing.

Write unit tests in lib/pachinko/pachinko.test.ts and standalone verifier scripts/verify-pachinko-sim.mjs proving seeded determinism (identical bucket counts and trajectories for identical seeds), dedupe 'DUP' bounce behavior, two-ball join merge and lone-ball timeout release, 6-bucket partition distribution, consecutive DLQ streak of 3 triggering pagerActive (while 2 consecutive DLQ hits followed by a normal bucket reset the streak without triggering), and record evidence in projects/otohime-dev-two-new-play-toys-paper-and-ink-style-bold-and-e/task-3-evidence.md.
non_goals: Matter.js or other third-party physics packages
DOM canvas rendering or React components

title: Pipeline Pachinko route, Play page discovery teasers, and E2E verification
acceptance_criteria: /play/pachinko renders the interactive ink-and-paper Pipeline Pachinko machine with pointer/keyboard plunger launch, Backfill flood button, rate-limited WebAudio peg clicks, mobile tilt-to-nudge and keyboard nudge controls, live 6-bucket bar chart and throttled aria-live readout (records/sec, late-arrival %, DLQ count), and a viewport-pinned focus-managed paper 'on-call pager' Easter egg on 3 consecutive DLQ hits, with both /play/booth and /play/pachinko linked from /play.
problem: Visitors cannot play Pipeline Pachinko at /play/pachinko or discover /play/booth and /play/pachinko from the main /play index page.
action_items: Read installed Next 16 docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing route code; build app/(site)/(app)/play/pachinko/page.tsx, app/(site)/(app)/play/pachinko/pachinko.css, and app/(site)/(app)/play/pachinko/_components/pachinko-machine.tsx rendering the ink-and-washi Canvas 2D pachinko board (plunger lane, ingest pegs, dedupe gate with 'DUP' stamps, join funnel, partition splitter into p0..p5, DLQ gutter, and live bucket bar chart).

Wire controls and audio on /play/pachinko: pointer drag-and-release plunger (with touch-action: none on the plunger/canvas), Space/Enter and visible 'Launch record' button, 'Backfill' flood button (spawning a staggered flood of 60 balls default, or a reduced 12-ball batch under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), DeviceOrientationEvent tilt-to-nudge behind an explicit permission button plus ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and on-screen nudge buttons, and rate-limited (<= 20/s, <= -18 dB) WebAudio peg-hit click sounds gated by the site sound toggle.

Render the live throughput readout (records/sec, late-arrival %, DLQ count) with a throttled (~1 s) aria-live='polite' summary, and implement the 3-in-a-row DLQ Easter egg: a paper 'on-call pager' gag dialog/card (data-testid='pachinko-pager', role='dialog', focus moved to its Acknowledge/Dismiss button via focus({ preventScroll: true })) pinned strictly inside both 1366x768 desktop and 390x844 mobile viewports (suppressing .rise transform on .rise:has(.pachinko-root)), plus deterministic URL/query or button support (?seed=... and ?fixture=dlq-streak or deterministic DLQ test trigger) alongside natural 3-DLQ streak triggering.

Update app/(site)/(app)/play/page.tsx to add paper-and-ink teaser sections and navigation links for both Ink Purikura Photobooth (/play/booth, data-testid='play-booth-link') and Pipeline Pachinko (/play/pachinko, data-testid='play-pachinko-link') alongside Hanafuda.

Add Chromium E2E tests in e2e/pachinko.test.ts verifying /play discovery links to /play/booth and /play/pachinko, plunger launch and Backfill increasing bucket counts and readouts, keyboard nudge and sound-off-by-default negative control, prefers-reduced-motion behavior, and the 3-consecutive-DLQ on-call pager Easter egg appearing strictly inside the 390x844 mobile and 1366x768 desktop viewports with focus management; record evidence in projects/otohime-dev-two-new-play-toys-paper-and-ink-style-bold-and-e/task-4-evidence.md.
